decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already updates the FAQ's block-prize figures to the new Small and Big Block parameters.
A same-message MODIFY already changes the Big Block winner count to 3 and draw condition to every 35,000 sales; the $6,000 amount remains unchanged.
A same-message MODIFY already changes the Small Block winner count to 3 and sales-count trigger to 750; the $900 amount remains unchanged.
Changing block-prize counts and draw frequencies does not change the current or planned product name.
The source retains the Small and Big Block draws and does not change their Chainlink VRF selection method, execution, fairness, or verification surface.
The source changes prize winner counts and draw frequencies but does not change the mint price, commission, founder share, or prize-pool destinations.
Both Small and Big Block mechanisms remain active, so their ticket counters and the other metadata fields remain valid unchanged.
The revised prize amounts and draw frequencies do not alter how book access, referral identity, badges, or active and expired tickets behave after NFT transfer.
The source does not resolve or alter whether prize payouts are automatic or manually claimed, nor does it change the claim control or surface.
The source changes block-prize winner counts and draw frequencies but does not change the recipient or the 4 Small and 3 Big tickets issued per coded referral mint.
The source changes draw parameters but does not alter ticket eligibility, post-draw burning and reset, or carry-forward behavior.
The source does not change the flat $48 royalty, its disclosure, its contribution to prize pools, or the rule that royalties do not create tickets.
